targets.evidence_quote: Zhao, Seibert and Hills (“ZSH”) developed an important framework in their 2005 article in the Journal of Applied Psychology. Using a sample of MBA students, ZSH found that entrepreneurial self-efficacy mediated the relationship between certain factors and entrepreneurial intentions. In this study, we conduct a “quasi replication” and extension of the ZSH results.
targets.outcome_quote: Using a sample of adults in the U.S., we both replicate key findings but also find considerable heterogeneity in effect sizes across certain sample sub-groups.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors say they replicate key findings; heterogeneity in effect sizes alone does not establish mixed outcomes. Abstract lacks full target citation and references, so title and DOI are left empty.
